Name: AstroOverlookArea
Notes: An area that determines the text layout to use for the Observatory's viewing platforms. Must be used in conjunction with AstroOverlookObj.

Obj_arg0.Name: Text Layout
Obj_arg0.Description: Determines the layout used by the game. Used specifically to differentiate the Front and Back viewing platforms.

SW_APPEAR.Description: Appears when this switch is activated.

SW_AWAKE.Description: Enables rendering and resumes updates when this switch is active.
